sanskrit_verse:
पितृमातृसुतभ्रातृश्वश्रूश्वशुरमातुलैः ।
हीना न स्याद् विना भर्त्रा गर्हणीयान्यथा भवेत् ॥
transliteration: pitṛmātṛsutabhrātṛśvaśrūśvaśuramātulaiḥ | hīnā na syād vinā bhartrā garhaṇīyānyathā bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: A woman is not diminished in status when she is without a husband, provided she maintains her relationship with father, mother, son, brother, sister-in-law, father-in-law, mother-in-law, and maternal uncle.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through relational integrity, not marital dependency
Causation arises from conscious relational continuity, not institutional constructs
Capacity-based responsibility lies in sustaining familial dharma, independent of spousal validation
Restoration logic prioritizes relational harmony over structural dependency
Consciousness alignment occurs through maintenance of dharmic kinship bonds
executable_legal_axioms: IF woman lacks husband THEN rights/status remain intact IF kinship relations are actively maintained
IF familial bond continuity is preserved THEN legal diminishment SHALL NOT occur
IF spousal absence exists AND relational integrity is sustained THEN social/legal capacity remains unchanged
IF kinship network is disrupted due to negligence THEN restoration protocol activates automatically
IF woman's autonomy increases through self-sustained relational integrity THEN societal integration deepens
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving women’s legal standing post-marital dissolution, courts must recognize that status is preserved by active engagement within extended family structures. The threshold of responsibility lies not in spousal presence but in continuity of dharma-based relational duties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that identity and entitlement derive from sustained relational action, not passive dependency. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that loss of husband does not inherently disrupt woman’s lawful position. Proportional responsibility aligns with maintenance of dharmic ties. Non-punitive reality rule confirms no degradation occurs where relational integrity persists.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process to reaffirm existing familial bonds if disruption detected
Assign responsibility assumption protocols to ensure continued care exchange among kin
Activate capacity restoration measures through community support for autonomous functioning
Implement integrity reintegration via ceremonial acknowledgment of sustained relational role
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as Source: Womanhood retains full dharma-derived authority sans marital condition. Dharma is restored through recognition of relational completeness. Reality reflects non-punitivity where consciousness upholds kinship truth. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
